title: Nuclear Posture Review and the motive to discredit witnesses

tellings.quote: nuclear deterrence is the backbone the basis of our national security.

plain: Robert Salas, a former US Air Force officer, told podcast host Jesse Michels that the Nuclear Posture Review, a Pentagon document setting out US nuclear weapons policy, calls nuclear deterrence "the backbone" of national security. Salas offers this as the reason, going back to the 1950s, why the military would want to discredit people who report UFOs near nuclear weapons: admitting that something could interfere with them would undercut the country's main defense.
